scope: Dependencies for the supported GreenQUIC+ P5/P7 paper reproduction workflow

msquic.note: The repository contains a modified MsQuic source tree. Exact reproducibility is defined by the GreenQUIC-Plus main commit SHA, not by fetching stock MsQuic 2.4.8.

dpdk.note: The DPDK source is vendored in the repository and built by the supported setup.

operating_system.version_pinning: codename pinned; exact apt package and kernel patch versions are not pinned by the setup script
operating_system.note: The setup validates ID=debian and VERSION_CODENAME=trixie on both endpoints.

control_host.paper_default: macOS Mac used as CONTROL HOST
control_host.note: Only the CONTROL HOST needs private GitHub credentials.

package_version_policy.debian_packages: not individually pinned; resolved from the configured Debian Trixie repositories at setup time
package_version_policy.why: The current setup intentionally uses the Debian Trixie package set rather than hard-coded package revisions.
package_version_policy.reproducibility_action: Record the effective package/tool/kernel versions for every evaluation environment; do not claim an unrecorded package revision was used in the paper.

paper_hardware_assumptions.hugepages: 16384 x 2 MiB on the test-NIC NUMA node
